# Evidence and guarantees

Reliability is **guaranteed** by integration tests. <!-- want "filler.unscoped-assurance" -->

The check passes, so nothing is taken on trust. <!-- want "filler.unscoped-assurance" -->

Tests check reliability under the supported failure modes.

The lock guarantees exclusive access.

Nothing from an unauthenticated request is taken on trust.

```text
Testing guarantees reliability.
```
